extraction.Name: Joseph Larvie
extraction.Buyer: Joseph Larvie and wife conveyed to Joseph D. Keller for $5600
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612467 issued; Southwest quarter section 28, township 100, north of range 76; receipt signed by allottee May 14, 1918; Contract for deed dated May 16, 1918, between Joseph Larvie and J. D. Keeler, for $5600 ($500 down and $5100 remainder); Deed dated May 18, 1918
